edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising out of the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).
edits.name: Dispute scope

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] by wire transfer of immediately available funds no later than [TIME AND TIME ZONE] on [DATE], to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Payment is complete only upon receipt of the full settlement amount in cleared funds.
edits.name: Payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims arising out of the Dispute based on acts or omissions occurring on or before the date of this Agreement. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it.
edits.name: Limited release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, regulation, or legal process; reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement; or made to professional advisers who are subject to professional duties of confidentiality or agree to maintain confidentiality. Any permitted disclosure shall be limited to information reasonably necessary for its purpose.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions
